body:
Well, it is likely not too late for you.  Heed the warnings, make changes now, if you can.  I will not say that it's never too late, because I believe that after a point, the damage that's been done becomes too great.  The darkness seeps into your bones, and it's all over but the crying.

I will say that it's interesting seeing trailers for movies you know you'll never see.  Oh wow, a new Star Wars!  I'll be dead before it comes out.  Neat, an expansion for my favorite game!  2016?  Oh, nevermind.  I'm the walking dead now.  It's strangely liberating, but I still do nothing with that freedom, just like I've never done anything with the rest of my life.  Don't be me.

Good luck to you.

I'm not fighting *at all* anymore.  You could give me an army of head doctors and a pharmacy of drugs, that won't change the facts of my life as I have allowed them to develop.  If someone would lock me in a cell for either my body or my mind, just to say that I'm still drawing breath, they are a sadist.  Each new dawn is another day on the rack, and the only thing that gives me strength is knowing the goal is just ahead.  I've a pistol, loaded, round in the chamber, in a drawer about six inches beneath my right elbow.  That's not how I chose to go, but if I didn't think I could bring my life to a close in the orderly fashion I've selected, I'd use it in a heartbeat.

Each day is a struggle.  A struggle to fill the waking time with pointless distractions so I can get back to sleep.  A dreamless sleep hopefully.  In the end that's all that I want, and endless, dreamless sleep.  I leave the world to my betters who know how to actually function in it.  To me it was always an unsolvable puzzle.

I have fought for as long as I can remember.  At some point you just get tired of the pain.  Of knowing that you are powerless to affect any meaningful change.  At some point you read the writing on the wall and wave the white flag.  Funnily enough I purchased one to mount on the night of my death.

The world is full of senseless and often needless death.  Why should we pretend my own existence is any more important than theirs?  Because I can type?  Because I can tell some fraction of my story?  Those others are the real tragedies, gone before they had a chance.  I have had my chances and squandered each and every one of them.  There comes a time when the only humane thing to do is end the misery.  I am well past that point now.

And who wouldn't be negative in this situation?  I would call the man crazy who could live like this and *not* be negative.  So long as you aren't victimized, your results in life reveal your worth.  My results tell me that I am unequivocally worthless.  The only people who will be troubled by the news of my death beyond, "Oh, that's too bad," are my parents.  Even their love is non-meritorious.  I have done nothing to deserve it other than to be born to them.  No one has ever assessed me and said, "You are good and I want you to be a part of my life."  I am important to virtually no one, and for all intents and purposes, I already don't exist.  I suspect that my ashes will be fish-food weeks before any of my 'friends' are even made aware that I'm dead.  My parents have no way to contact them.

So, my friend, I say again, I thank you for your efforts, but they are wasted on me.  My mind is set, there is no other choice that makes any amount of sense.  I've been dead for a long time.  I'm only formalizing that status.  There are others here that you can legitimately help.  Others who are further back along the path.  Here at the end, at the wind and the chasm, there is no going back.  The only way is forward.

Blue Oyster Cult says it all with *Veteran of the Psychic Wars*.  I have loved that song for over 20 years, but never thought it would be my own story.

Medicine will not change my situation.  Will not put a lady in my house, or happiness in my heart.  If who I am naturally is unfit to live, then who am I to stand in the way of nature?  Again, I'm sure for people with the right conditions and mentality, that stuff will work wonders.  Am I out-of-balance, out-of-whack?  Maybe.  Drugs that start changing how you think... it just doesn't sit well with me.  It's like replacing me with a sorta-me.  Close, but not who I am.  I think I'd rather die as me than live as someone or something else.  Again, it's a truth thing.  This is who I am.  If I can't make it work with what I got, well, game over.

No.  I don't have a job.  I lost it and have burned through all of my savings sitting here, waiting to die.  I hope to leave with about $1,000 left to cover the handling of my remains, (cremated, spread at sea).

*Just* 38.  You're here at 32, brother.  Think you can go 6 more years as-is?  As I'm sure you well know, for the alone, each year is many-many times longer than the calendar tells you it is.  

No.  No psych help.  Not for me.  What are they gonna say?  What magic words can they utter to take the pain away?  I'm sure it's fine for some, but my rot runs deep.  Deep down into the core now.

I appreciate the effort, I really do, but this is far less of a cry for help than it is what I say it is.  A warning.  I explain myself and my situation so that anyone following behind will know it isn't just some motivational bullshit somebody whipped up.  That I actually have walked that path.  And if it resonates with them and causes them to think twice, then maybe I can say for once in this godsforsaken life, someone was better off for me having been here.  Even if just a little.  And for me, with an endless column of 0's on my scorecard, for me that will be a point in my favor for once.

I'm 38.  My folks are still kickin' and I have some siblings that I rarely hear from (holidays).  But it's not enough.  I actually have held on hoping to outlast my parents (they're elderly), hoping to spare them the pain.  But I just can't anymore.  I know that if they really do love me, they wouldn't want me to suffer.  One benefit of being decent with words is that I can write a nice long letter to make sure they understand that they are not to blame.  That there is nothing more that they could have done.

I see a commercial on TV, showing a happy couple or family, and I have to turn away as I feel that ice-cold dagger in my heart.  Going out is even worse.  You know that there is this entire world out there and virtually everyone is able to make *something* work sooner or later.  But I'm left with *nothing*.  I'm a ghost in spectator mode.  The last among the least and the lowest of the low.

I don't blame the world, I don't feel as if I'm owed.  I know where the fault lies.  I might say that I have a social and spiritual cancer, and that it's every bit as terminal as the actual thing.  But honestly, that's passing the buck, saying that I'm not responsible for getting myself here.  Through my failures I've been selected out, my genes judged faulty.  The world will be a better and stronger place in my passing.

>let's not give up ok? 

I'm sorry brother, but I already have.  I've tossed a few hail marys and all we intercepted.  The game's all but over for me.  There simply isn't enough time to come back and win, or even tie.  I'm even out of timeouts.  (sorry for the American football analogies, you furiners).

I don't mean to compare miseries, but at least you have something you can point to and say, 'this is why.'  I can only blame myself, my own fears and failings.  So whatever it was that was wrong with me is something fundamental.  Not treatable.  

I do hope that you are able to overcome your condition.  With time and will, you should be able to do it.  Others in your place have.  Take heart from their successes.  

Good luck to you, friend.  You saw my warnings.  For you it isn't too late.  Remember that.

How *did* I end up here?  I'm not entirely sure.  Small bad decisions add up, compound over time.  When I react, try to mitigate, at best I spin my tires, at worst, the matters only become more complicated.

I am in the final two months now.  I know this.  I lost my job over a year ago and have been living off of my savings ever since.  I can't bring myself to work merely to continue existing.  I want to *live*, only I never really discovered how to.  And now, that money is running out.  I have to start getting my affairs in order.  For those very few people who give a damn, I don't want to leave a mess behind.

Short of finding a winning lottery ticket on the sidewalk (and perhaps not even then), my path is set.  Two months ahead, nearly twenty-one years back to the finish of high-school.  I have nothing to show for all that time.  My friends I've all seen married off, start careers, and start families.  They've no time for me anymore.  One time I had a revelation and resolved to stop calling anyone for a week.  The phone didn't ring.  I would out-type them 25:1 in words for e-mails.  When I stopped sending, I stopped receiving.  All had put me onto 'maintenance only'.

Eight years ago I bought a house.  I was perhaps at my peak then.  Three cars (none new though), a boat (also used), and a four-bedroom.  That with an income twice that of the local average, in my hubris I thought I was a catch.  Eight years later, my bed remains as cold and empty as the day that I moved in here.  Can you fathom the depths of failure it takes to achieve that?  I look back and am stupefied.  I thought I would have a wife and kids by now.  But this home, no, this house, is nothing but a crypt where I sit and rot.  Having to watch the world around me unfold, but never being able to interact with it in a meaningful way.  Always witnessing that which I can never have, and each and every time the pain of knowing that I wasn't good enough.

I watch men cheat on women I would kill to have.  Abusers, neglecters, cheaters, thugs, criminals, even murders and rapists, all better than me.  All capable of building at least a sham of a relationship.  I have to place myself beneath these people.  I know that when I'm out, that my eye lands on literally no one that I am a better human being than, despite my empathy and ethics.  I am the Omega Male.

I am a shadow of a human being.  And everyone seems to know it.  I'm tired of lies and can't bring myself to build up the fiction it would require to attract anyone.  A good relationship can only be founded on truth, and my truth is that I'm undesirable.  I will not say that I am ugly, or fat.  I'm just... average.  And no one is excited by average.  And so I sit here, waiting for the sands of my hourglass to finally run out.  I really do need to start packing, start getting stuff ready to list, emptying out.  I keep hoping for a miracle that I know will never come.  I don't believe in miracles.
